description: This file contains multiple class definitions for Orleans grains, including generic grains with various type parameters, state classes, grain implementations with storage providers, and some edge case testing classes for generic type handling and interface constraints.

classes.name: SimpleGenericGrainState
classes.description: State class holding two generic properties A and B of type T for a generic grain.

classes.name: SimpleGenericGrain1
classes.description: A generic grain with memory storage that provides methods to get/set properties A and B, and to get a formatted string of A and B.

classes.name: SimpleGenericGrainUsingAzureStorageAndLongGrainName
classes.description: A generic grain with Azure storage provider, supporting echo and clear state operations.

classes.name: TinyNameGrain
classes.description: A lightweight generic grain with Azure storage, supporting echo and clear state.

classes.name: SimpleGenericGrainUState
classes.description: State class with two properties of type U for a generic grain.

classes.name: SimpleGenericGrainU
classes.description: A generic grain with memory storage, similar to SimpleGenericGrain1 but with U type properties.

classes.name: SimpleGenericGrain2State
classes.description: State class with two properties of types T and U for a generic grain.

classes.name: SimpleGenericGrain2
classes.description: A generic grain with memory storage, supporting get/set operations and formatted string of T and U.

classes.name: GenericGrainWithNoProperties
classes.description: A generic grain with no stored properties, providing a method to get a formatted string of two T parameters.

classes.name: GrainWithNoProperties
classes.description: A non-generic grain with no stored properties, providing a method to get a formatted string of two integers.

classes.name: IGrainWithListFieldsState
classes.description: State class holding a list of strings.

classes.name: GrainWithListFields
classes.description: A grain managing a list of strings with methods to add and retrieve items.

classes.name: GenericGrainWithListFieldsState
classes.description: State class holding a list of generic type T.

classes.name: GenericGrainWithListFields
classes.description: A generic grain managing a list of T with methods to add and retrieve items.

classes.name: GenericReaderWriterState
classes.description: State class with a single value of type T.

classes.name: GenericReader2State
classes.description: State class with two values of types TOne and TTwo.

classes.name: GenericReaderWriterGrain2State
classes.description: State class with two values of types TOne and TTwo, used in a generic grain.

classes.name: GenericReader3State
classes.description: State class with three values of types TOne, TTwo, TThree.

classes.name: GenericReaderWriterGrain1
classes.description: A generic grain with memory storage for a single value of type T, supporting set/get operations.

classes.name: GenericReaderWriterGrain2
classes.description: A generic grain with memory storage for two values of types TOne and TTwo, supporting set/get operations.

classes.name: GenericReaderWriterGrain3
classes.description: A generic grain with memory storage for three values of types TOne, TTwo, TThree, supporting set/get operations.

classes.name: BasicGenericGrain
classes.description: A generic grain with two type parameters T and U, storing and formatting these properties.

classes.name: HubGrain
classes.description: A generic base class for hub grains with a virtual method Bar.

classes.name: EchoHubGrain
classes.description: A derived hub grain that implements message handling and tracks an integer x.

classes.name: EchoGenericChainGrain
classes.description: A generic grain that chains echo calls across grains with the same type parameter T.

classes.name: NonGenericBaseGrain
classes.description: A non-generic base grain with a simple Ping method.

classes.name: Generic1ArgumentGrain
classes.description: A generic grain implementing IGeneric1Argument with a Ping method.

classes.name: Generic1ArgumentDerivedGrain
classes.description: A derived generic grain implementing IGeneric1Argument.

classes.name: Generic2ArgumentGrain
classes.description: A generic grain with two type parameters, providing a Ping method returning a tuple.

classes.name: Generic2ArgumentsDerivedGrain
classes.description: A derived grain with two type parameters, implementing a Ping method.

classes.name: DbGrain
classes.description: A grain that stores a value of type T with get/set methods.

classes.name: PingSelfGrain
classes.description: A reentrant grain implementing self-pinging and scheduling with timers, supporting cancellation and deactivation.

classes.name: LongRunningTaskGrain
classes.description: A grain that performs long-running tasks, supports cancellation, and tracks last value.

classes.name: Reducer
classes.description: Interface for a reducer handling state and actions.

classes.name: Reducer1
classes.description: Implementation of a reducer handling string state and Reducer1Action.

classes.name: Reducer2
classes.description: Implementation of a reducer handling int state and Reducer2Action.

classes.name: IUnmanagedArgGrain
classes.description: Interface for grains with unmanaged type arguments, supporting echo methods.

classes.name: UnmanagedArgGrain
classes.description: Implementation of IUnmanagedArgGrain with unmanaged type T.

classes.name: IReducerGameGrain
classes.description: Interface for a grain that applies a reducer to go from previous to new state.

classes.name: ReducerGameGrain
classes.description: Implementation of a reducer grain that applies a reducer to process state.

classes.name: BasicEdgeCaseGrain
classes.description: Abstract class for edge case testing with generic arguments.

classes.name: PartiallySpecifyingGrain
classes.description: A grain with partially specified generic arguments.

classes.name: GrainWithPartiallySpecifyingInterface
classes.description: A grain implementing an interface with generic arguments.

classes.name: GrainSpecifyingSameGenArgTwice
classes.description: A grain specifying the same generic argument twice.

classes.name: SpecifyingRepeatedGenArgsAmongstOthers
classes.description: A grain with repeated generic arguments among others.

classes.name: GrainForTestingCastingBetweenInterfacesWithReusedGenArgs
classes.description: A grain for testing interface casting with reused generic arguments.

classes.name: SpecifyingSameGenArgsButRearranged
classes.description: A grain with rearranged generic arguments.

classes.name: GrainForTestingCastingWithRearrangedGenArgs
classes.description: A grain for testing interface casting with rearranged generic arguments.

classes.name: GrainWithGenArgsUnrelatedToFullySpecifiedGenericInterface
classes.description: A grain with unrelated generic arguments to a fully specified interface.

classes.name: GrainSupplyingFurtherSpecializedGenArg
classes.description: A grain supplying a further specialized generic argument.

classes.name: GrainSupplyingGenArgSpecializedIntoArray
classes.description: A grain supplying a specialized generic argument into an array.

classes.name: GrainForCastingBetweenInterfacesOfFurtherSpecializedGenArgs
classes.description: A grain for testing casting between interfaces with further specialized generic arguments.
